Neither option is correct. Under Articles 31–32 of the Vienna Convention, treaties are interpreted in good faith, starting from the ordinary meaning of their terms in context and in light of their object and purpose, with preparatory work as a supplementary means. If I must pick one of the two, the first is closer because it refers to the parties' intention and preparatory works, but it omits the primacy of ordinary meaning.
CONFIDENCE: 85
